app_info.subtitle: SEO insights from GSC & GA4
app_info.description: SEO Gets connects ChatGPT directly to your Google Search Console and GA4 data. Ask about performance trends, generate reports and action plans, check indexing status and errors, and query performance by page, keyword, or date range across any connected property. SEO Gets enriches raw GSC data with content groups, topic clusters, and brand keyword filtering, so answers reflect how you’ve actually organized your site, not just raw rows from the API. You can also compare performance across multiple connected properties in a single conversation. Built for SEO strategists, agencies, consultants, and in-house teams who need direct answers from their GSC data.
